display_name: 51. 정답 없는 FR 세부 지표 후보의 타당성 검증
question: Can any reference-free spatial-detail index rank fusion outputs by fidelity when the truth is known (experiment 46 ground-truth ranking test)? Only passing indices may later be proposed for the FR judgement.

protocol.data: RR test 20 scenes; RR PAN/LMS/MS are treated exactly as FR inputs; GT is used only to measure fidelity (as experiment 46)
protocol.candidates: experiment 46 set (GT, LMS, MTF_GLP, 43 C0-C3 x seeds 42-44 with and without the 45 P5 projection, C0/C2 s42 blends toward GT t=0.25/0.5/0.75 and toward LMS t=0.25/0.5) plus 49 F1 seeds 42-44
protocol.reproduction_check: toolbox-1.0 D_s of GT, LMS and C0_s42 must equal experiment 46 results/validity.json (1e-9)

indices.PDC_corr: PAN detail correlation: fit P_lr ~ sum_b w_b MS_b + c by least squares on the MS grid (P_lr = PAN blurred with the QB PAN MTF, GNyq 0.15, and decimated x4 at phase 2); I_F = sum_b w_b F_b + c; HP(X) = X - PAN-MTF blur(X); index = 1 - corr(HP(I_F), HP(PAN)) over the image interior (margin 8). Lower is better
indices.PDC_nrmse: same I_F and HP: RMSE(HP(I_F) - HP(PAN)) / RMSE(HP(PAN)). Lower is better
indices.BandHP_corr: 1 - mean over bands of corr(HP(F_b), HP(PAN)) over the interior. Lower is better
indices.D_rho_style: local correlation idea of Scarpa et al. 2022: rho_b(x) = Pearson correlation of F_b and PAN in a sliding 4x4 window (ratio); index = mean over bands and pixels of (1 - rho_b(x)). Our implementation, not checked against the authors code. Lower is better

tests.T1_truth_ranking: scenes where index(GT) is better than the mean over the three C0 seeds; valid >= 15/20, conflicting <= 5/20
tests.T2_fidelity_rank: per scene Spearman(MSE vs GT, index badness) over all candidates, median over scenes; valid >= +0.5, conflicting <= -0.5
tests.T3_monotone_blend: scenes where t=0.75 toward GT scores better than t=0 (C0 s42 and C2 s42 separately); reported
tests.T4_truth_best: scenes where GT has the best index among all candidates; reported
tests.decision: per index: passes if T1 valid AND T2 >= +0.5; conflicts if T1 conflicting AND T2 <= -0.5; otherwise mixed (same rule as experiment 46)

use_of_result: a passing index is a candidate for a later FR guard; adding it to docs/judgement_criteria.md is a separate decision. This experiment changes no judgement
limits: RR-scale check of the scale-invariance assumption; it does not prove FR behaviour. QB only; exploratory test reused
